violations.description: Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Outer surfaces of refrigerated equipment throughout the kitchen were found dirty. Wire shelving in the walk-in cooler and throughout the kitchen were also found dirty. Cupboards under the plate storage on the buffet lines and portable fans in the kitchen were also found dirty. These areas should be cleaned and maintained clean.

Mechanical cleaning and sanitizing requirements. — --Sanitize solution for mechanical warewashing machine was not maintained at the proper concentration. Chlorine sanitizing solution in dish machine was found at 0ppm during inspection. Dish machine chlorine solutions should be maintained at 50ppm to sanitize food contact surfaces. ****Corrected during inspection.

Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was not provided in sufficient number and/or not accessible to allow convenient use by employees. Hand washing sink near dish washing area was found out of order. Hand washing sinks should be maintained in working order.

Prep/vegetable sink. — --Designated prep sink was not provided or not used for food items requiring washing/soaking. Sign on prep sink said do not use. Prep sink should be maintained in working condition.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Flooring found dirty throughout the kitchen and in the walk-in cooler. Floors should be cleaned and maintained clean. Ceiling vents were found dirty throughout the kitchen. These should be cleaned and maintained clean. Multiple light covers were found broken/cracked. Light covers should be maintained in good repair.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. Wiping cloth bucket sanitizing solutions were found at 0ppm during inspection. Quaternary ammonia solutions should be maintained at 200-400ppm, per manufacturer directions.
Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Expired bucket of macaroni salad was found in the front refrigerated prep table. Expired food items should be discarded.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Refrigerated equipment throughout the kitchen was found dirty, inside and out. Wire shelving in the walk-in cooler and throughout the kitchen were also found dirty. Cupboards under the plate storage on the buffet lines and portable fan on the counter in the pizza prep area were also found dirty. These should be cleaned and maintained clean.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Flooring found dirty throughout the kitchen and in the walk-in cooler and freezer. Floors should be cleaned and maintained clean. Ceiling vents were found dirty near the pizza oven. These should be cleaned and maintained clean.

Employee dressing areas and lockers. — --Employees' clothing/possessions were in an area where contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single-service items may occur. Personal food and drink items were found on multiple prep tables in the kitchen. Personal items should be stored separate from items used for food service.
